title: Same-Day Duplicate Charge Goodwill: Computation of the Amount
content:
# Computation of the duplicate-charge goodwill

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

## Charge the schedule reads

The schedule reads the customer's most recently refunded domain auto-renew charge, meaning the domain refund line of charge type auto-renew with the latest refund date, where no other domain auto-renew refund line shares that refund date, whenever the refunded charge's domain shows two or more auto-renew charge lines dated the same day as that charge. A refunded auto-renew charge without such a same-day twin, or a latest refund date shared by another auto-renew refund line, is outside this schedule. The refund line points to the charge it refunded; that charge is the duplicate.

## Computation

(a) The days until the duplicate was refunded are the calendar days from the duplicate charge's date to its refund line's date.

(b) The duplicate-charge goodwill figure is 0.25 (25 percent) of the duplicate charge's amount.

(c) For a grant under this schedule the yearly goodwill total is the sum of the goodwill entries dated after the same calendar date one year before today, a grant may not exceed the tier's per-case goodwill limit nor bring that yearly goodwill total above the tier's yearly goodwill limit, and a grant beyond either limit is made only up to the remaining limit; a goodwill grant made under none of Harborline's published service-failure goodwill schedules (late hosting provisioning, late recovery review decisions, same-day duplicate domain auto-renew charges, late certificate issuance, late recovery resets and late refund postings) remains under the base limit sentence.

(d) The duplicate-charge goodwill granted is the duplicate-charge goodwill figure limited in that way and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; where the limited amount is zero, nothing is owed under this schedule and no entry is posted.

(e) In working the figure through to the amount granted, the fixed uplifts that apply are added to the duplicate-charge goodwill figure, the limits are then applied, and only the final figure is rounded half up to the cent.

The per-case and yearly limits are the figures of the account's tier in the goodwill limits by tier.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A .net domain shows two auto-renew charge lines of $19.64 dated 8 April; one of them was refunded on 10 April and no other auto-renew refund line is dated 10 April. Figure: 25 percent of $19.64, $4.91. On a Harborline Personal Account with no goodwill in the year, the per-case limit of $25.00 and the yearly room of $50.00 leave the figure unchanged, and $4.91 is granted.

## Excluded cases

| Situation on the domain billing history | Within the schedule |
|---|---|
| only one auto-renew charge line on the refunded charge's date | No |
| two auto-renew refund lines share the latest refund date | No |
| two or more same-day auto-renew charge lines, and a single latest auto-renew refund line | Yes |
